title: Vitamin F (Linoleic Acid) for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Linoleic Acid (Vitamin F) for Hair: What the Research Shows | FullyVital
seo_description: What a review and a lab study show about linoleic acid and hair growth, why oil choice matters for skin, and what hasn't been tested in people.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) claimed hair growth benefits. Rewritten around two hair-relevant sources (a review and a cell study) and the skin-oil review.
flags: Mentions DKK-1 and dihydrotestosterone-related alopecia as part of the cell study; informational.
'Vitamin F is the name sometimes given to essential fatty acids' is general, from the page's own topic; not in an abstract.
I did not cite the 1977 case report on topical linoleic acid in essential fatty acid deficiency (it mentions hair depigmentation changing), to avoid any pigment-reversal implication.
